title: ADR-027 D1 executed — the teacher marking surfaces become enrollment-scoped (teacher → classes → members), out-of-scope answers invisible on reads and honestly SKIPPED on the batch, receipts attached
operator_order_trace: 1a15ece07422fcd9 (the approved queue: T-TEACH-001 my-courses → T-TEACH-002 feature toggles → T-TEACH-003 this task → T-TEACH-004 core class workspace parity); session web-590847c1 order 'Proceed with T-TEACH-003'
what_shipped: apps/api services/teachermarking/index.ts — the D1 law at every bound surface: the marking queue (assemble), answersList, answersPaged (page query AND the database count), the rich answerById, and throughput (answersByState group-by, pending-by-paper leaders, oldest-pending, and the humanMarks 24h/7d windows now count marks on IN-SCOPE answers only) all carry an inline EXISTS predicate over teacher → classes → class_members → attempts.learner_id

EXISTS, never an inner join: a learner enrolled in two of the teacher's classes must not duplicate queue rows; computed LIVE per request (D4 — no snapshot, no cache; the enrollment join is the single source of truth)

single-answer paths: markAnswer and recordHumanMark fold the same enrollment join into their FIRST lookup — an out-of-scope answer 404s exactly like a nonexistent one BEFORE the attempt lock or any state load (no existence leak; D1 'teacher-invisible'); the lock-first evidence law is preserved (the gate precedes the lock, no state is read before either)

smartMarkBatch(answerIds, teacherId): scope resolves once per batch (live), per-item classification — missing id → FAILED 'answer not found' (unchanged); out-of-scope → the NEW honest SKIPPED_OUT_OF_SCOPE outcome with reason 'out of scope: the learner is not enrolled in one of your classes' and marksAwarded NULL (rendering the learner's marks would leak answer state to a teacher who must not see the answer); non-PENDING → SKIPPED_ALREADY_MARKED (unchanged); dispatched items re-ride markAnswer's own gate (a mid-batch un-enrollment answers FAILED 'answer not found', never a mark on a revoked learner); the view's skipped count covers both SKIPPED_* outcomes

packages/contracts teacher-marking.ts: smartMarkBatchItemSchema outcome enum gains SKIPPED_OUT_OF_SCOPE — the ADR-027-mandated SKIPPED-family extension of the frozen three-value set (:361-384); every captured wire posture still parses (captured bodies only ever carry MARKED / SKIPPED_ALREADY_MARKED); contracts test amended with a justified:true note citing the ADR

apps/api routes/teachermarking.ts: every surface hands the JWT identity to the service as the scope principal (answers, queue-v2, throughput, smart-mark-batch, answers/:id, answers/:id/smart-mark; human-mark already passed it as markerId — it now doubles as the principal); the scope decision is the SERVICE layer's law, the route only carries the identity
apps/hub lib/types.ts: the SmartMarkBatchItem mirror gains SKIPPED_OUT_OF_SCOPE (additive; the console's only outcome branch is 'FAILED' — no behavior change)

golden/tools/seed-t51-rich200.ts (--stage attempts / all): stage 5b — the SCOPE-COVERAGE state. The marking rich-200 captures were taken under ADR-027's interim pilot-scope mode; once the surfaces are enrollment-scoped they reproduce only when the replaying teacher's scope covers the attempting learner. t51-student (User 1, who made the two pinned attempts) is enrolled into one ACTIVE class per replay teacher present on the instrument db: the t51 bootstrap admin (ADMIN+TEACHER — the local runner's marking bearer) and user_20 (the ci-replay TEACHER token, minted before staging runs). Deterministic per-teacher fixed uuids, idempotent (on conflict do nothing), honest skip when a teacher row is absent

tests: test/teachermarking/teachermarking.test.ts — every call passes the scope principal; new pins: the scope join rides the FIRST query of both write paths (params [answerId, teacherId]) and the queue/throughput/batch queries (params pin the principal); out-of-scope markAnswer/recordHumanMark 404 with the lock never taken; out-of-scope answerById renders null with NO tail lookups; SKIPPED_OUT_OF_SCOPE honest body + skipped-count bucket; empty scope = honest empty queue; the scoped human-window query shape; test/teachermarking/routes.test.ts — every fake call pin gains the identity + two new delegation pins (answerById, markAnswer)

design_decision_of_record.membership_rows_are_the_law: D4's only stated revocation is un-enrollment; an ARCHIVED class keeps its roster — so pending work never vanishes from a teacher's queue by an archive action, and re-enrollment restores prospective visibility exactly as the ADR words it. Class status is deliberately NOT a scope filter (disclosed reading; any future conflict re-opens the ADR, not the implementation).
design_decision_of_record.exists_not_join: inline EXISTS per read site (one bind: the teacher id) — duplicate-proof against multi-class membership, snapshot-free, and it composes with the frozen grouping/ordering semantics untouched (ADR D5 + implementation note: 'grouping/ordering semantics are orthogonal and unchanged').
design_decision_of_record.kappa_untouched: evaluateAgreement / latestEvaluation ride UNCHANGED per ADR-027's own implementation note — the human sample composes upstream (marks can only ARISE in scope through the now-gated write paths; pre-existing pilot rows were legitimately collected under the pilot-staff umbrella per D4's no-erasure clause). Gate math, threshold, and both scopes are byte-identical.
design_decision_of_record.no_schema_change: ADR-027: 'No schema change is required by THIS record' — classes/class_members already exist (T-MIG-052); zero migration, zero Flyway-era contact, zero DB writes of any kind shipped.
design_decision_of_record.admin_parity: the scope principal is the JWT identity regardless of role — an ADMIN sees only learners enrolled in classes THEY own (D1 ranks the enrollment join with backend RBAC; admin is not a scope grant).
design_decision_of_record.contract_extension_justified: GOLDEN_MASTER §4 escape used for the outcome enum: the operator-authored ADR mandates the SKIPPED-family outcome ('never silently dropped, never fabricated'); the frozen values stay legal and every recorded body still parses — a widening the core never needed because the core lived entirely in pilot-scope mode.
